payload.summary: Classify scripts/run-next-build.mjs in CI change scope (build and container)
payload.detail: PR #3780 moved the next build step of build:internal into scripts/run-next-build.mjs. A later change to that file alone classifies as build_changed=false and container_changed=false in scripts/ci-change-scope.mjs, so the build and Docker jobs would not run for it. Fix: add run-next-build to the buildPatterns and containerPatterns script regexes and the container self-test list (the patch was written and dropped from #3780). Editing ci-change-scope.mjs is a required-check change, so the PR needs a body line `Required check change approved: <reason>` citing the owner yes.
